```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(benchmarkme)
library(plotly)
library(treemapify)
```

## Result pre-processing

```{r dataLoading}
objectSize <- read.table(file = params$sizeInputPath, header = TRUE)
objectSize$nCell <- as.factor(objectSize$nCell)
objectSize$rep <- as.factor(objectSize$rep)

dataFrames <- lapply(list.files(path = params$memoryUsageInputDir, full.names = TRUE),
       function(x){
            df <- read.csv(x)
            total_time <- sum(df$Elapsed_Time_sec, na.rm = TRUE)
            df %>% 
                mutate(ratioTime = Elapsed_Time_sec / total_time)
       })
names(dataFrames) <- list.files(path = params$memoryUsageInputDir, full.names = FALSE)
names(dataFrames) <- gsub(pattern = ".csv", replacement = "", x = names(dataFrames))
print(names(dataFrames))
benchmarkDF <- bind_rows(dataFrames, .id = "run")
benchmarkDF <- separate_wider_delim(data = benchmarkDF, cols = c("run"), delim = "_",
                          names = c("nCell", "replicate"))

benchmarkDF$vignette_step <- gsub(pattern = "(.*leduc)(.*)([.,/(]leduc.*)",
                                  replacement = "\\2",
                                  x = benchmarkDF$Function_Call)
irrelevantIndices <- c(grep("write.table", benchmarkDF$vignette_step),
                       grep("assaysNames", benchmarkDF$vignette_step))
benchmarkDF <- benchmarkDF[-irrelevantIndices,]
```


## Difference in final object size

```{r objectSizeComparaison}
plotSize <- objectSize %>%
    group_by(nCell) %>%
    summarise("sizeGB" = utils:::format.object_size(mean(size),
                                                       units = "GB")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = nCell, y = sizeGB, fill = nCell)) + geom_col()
ggplotly(plotSize)
```

## Difference in total run time

```{r timeBenchmark}
plotTime <- benchmarkDF %>%
    group_by(nCell, replicate) %>%
    summarise("time" = sum(Elapsed_Time_sec)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = nCell, y = time, color = nCell)) + geom_boxplot()
ggplotly(plotTime)
```


## Difference in peak RAM usage

```{r peakBenchmark}
plotPeak <- benchmarkDF %>%
    group_by(nCell, replicate) %>%
    summarise("peak" = max(Peak_RAM_Used_MiB)) %>%
    group_by(nCell) %>% 
    summarise("peak" = mean(peak)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = nCell, y = peak, fill = nCell)) + geom_col()
ggplotly(plotPeak)
```

```{r ratioBenchmark}
plotRatio <- benchmarkDF %>%
    group_by(vignette_step) %>%
    summarise(meanTimePercentage = mean(ratioTime)*100) %>%
    arrange(desc(meanTimePercentage)) %>%  # Sort by meanTimePercentage
    mutate(vignette_step = factor(vignette_step, levels = vignette_step)) %>%  # Reorder factor levels
    ggplot(aes(x = vignette_step, y = meanTimePercentage, fill = vignette_step)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity") +  # Bar segments
        labs(title = "Proportion of vignette_step by meanTimePercentage",
             y = "Percentage of time taken (average)", x = "Vignette Step") +  # Axis labels
        theme_minimal() +  # Minimal theme for cleaner look
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
ggplotly(plotRatio)



```

## Hardware and software

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
sd <- benchmarkme::get_sys_details()
cat("Machine: ", sd$sys_info$sysname, " (", sd$sys_info$release, ")\n",
    "R version: R.", sd$r_version$major, ".", sd$r_version$minor,
    " (svn: ", sd$r_version$`svn rev`, ")\n",
    "RAM: ", round(sd$ram / 1E9, 1), " GB\n",
    "CPU: ", sd$cpu$no_of_cores, " core(s) - ", sd$cpu$model_name, "\n",
    sep = "")
```
